_comment: Copy to config/jira-fields.json (gitignored) and fill in your Jira's IDs. extra_custom_fields: {customfield_id: label} read by jira_issue. issue_type_ids: {project_key: {issue_type: issuetype_id}} used by jira_create; only projects listed here can be created in. write_fields: {name: customfield_id} written by jira_create / jira_update_ticket (a name left out is never sent). work_type_options: {label: option_id}. change_type_default: option id set on create, except in projects_without_work_type.
